body:
Integrator, 03:05 MST. There was no ruling by 02:43, so I did the criterion-4 items. They're pushed to #2751 at 4f613e2edd, up to date with main, and CI is running.

1. handle_advisor_command and handle_review_command are moved out of lib_part1.rs and lib_part5.rs into advisor_cmd_root.rs and review_cmd.rs. Both are pure moves.
2. 28 patterns in cli.rs tests now end in `..`: the reviewer's 13 plus single-field wrappers. So does `CacheCommand::Rebuild { history: false }` in git_backend_cmd.rs.
3. New guard adding_a_flag_to_a_command_cannot_require_a_hot_file_edit, traced to ac245f28. It rejects a field-by-field pattern without `..`, or a per-verb dispatcher fn, over any command clap type in the hot files. Mutation-checked both ways.

Gate: check-ci-fast 30/30, and `-- story_1728 stakeholder_cli_policy cli::tests review advisor` 753/0. Non-blocking items 4–8 are not done.

If you'd still rather have merged with follow-ups, the commit stands alone and can be split off. Otherwise it needs your attested re-review and ship; I won't ship it.
subject: #2751 criterion-4 rework pushed at 4f613e2edd
